proposals.evidence: Platts p. 429 gives Persian ćarbī “fat, grease, suet, tallow”. The survey carbi/cerbi/corbi material-fat responses preserve its distinctive consonant skeleton; this does not cover unrelated adjectives meaning stout. Existing Hindi carbi “fat” (kannauji[p. 75]) supplies an attested provisional donor. Its locality is the attestation site; the historical lending locality and possible intervening Indo-Aryan language remain unknown. The borrowed edge is saved under the user’s explicit preference to link supported families despite unresolved cross-IA transmission.
